summary: An html field arrives as a string of the sf-rich-text subset and is saved as the string the editor cleaned: its markup kept, nothing outside the subset sent.

then.note: The value is a string, never a tree. The editor writes only the subset (p, h2-h4, strong, em, a with an https:, mailto:, tel: or site href, ul, ol, li, blockquote, br), so what the host receives already holds no script, style, on* attribute or javascript: link; the host still cleans what it stores by its own rule, since a save is not the only way a value reaches it. A value the host sends is cleaned again before it is drawn, so a stored value from elsewhere is never shown raw.
